esp32.detail: 5 pins wired; Added a 10 kΩ pull-up resistor from SDA to 3V3, as the datasheet requires. Added a 10 kΩ pull-up resistor from SCL to 3V3, as the datasheet requires. It shares the I2C bus (SDA D21, SCL D22) at address 0x39. Added the tsl2572.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the Ch0/Ch1 counts set on the sliders and the datasheet lux: passes
